sections.overall: A real one-two punch of Dynamite-Collision this week, the strongest pair of weekly shows in recent memory! The best match of the week was the Dynamite opener where Andrade El Idolo defended his new National Title against Jack Perry and Nick Wayne (8.09); the champ re-enters the top 10. Good gains for all involved!
sections.mens: Various small gains from the different multi-man matches. Will Ospreay vs Daniel Garcia, though decent (7.33), led to a slight loss for the former due to his high rating and therefore expectations.
sections.womens: Maya World had a better outing than Redemption in her first title defense against Persephone (6.52), though it was not as strong a match as the Trios on Collision. Welcome back Hazuki by the way!
sections.menstag: No tag matches this week as it was a Trios-heavy one. Though with the surprise MCMG appearance on Collision, hopefully this will change soon!
sections.womenstag: The Brawling Birds featured in the Collision Trios match (7.32), meaning they re-entered the rankings. Let's home some momentum builds in the division.
sections.trios: Three Men's Trios matches this week! The new champions, The Demand, re-enter at the top of the division. Already one defense on Collision under their belts too!
